title: Directorate of Public Instruction, Chhattisgarh Recruitment 2026 – Lecturer, Head Teacher Primary School, Head Teacher Upper Primary School, Assistant Teacher, Teacher, PET & Other Posts
shortInfo: Directorate of Public Instruction, Chhattisgarh has announced notification for Lecturer, Head Teacher Primary School, Head Teacher Upper Primary School, Assistant Teacher, Teacher, PET & Other posts. Required qualification: Post-graduate degree with B.Ed., Graduate with D.Ed./B.Ed./D.L.Ed., Higher Secondary with D.Ed./D.L.Ed., Graduate with B.Lib., Graduate in Computer Science/IT/Computer Application. Last date to apply: 21-10-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website: https://eduportal.cg.nic.in/
Read the full advertisement carefully before applying.
Fill in the online application form with accurate details.
Upload required documents as specified.
Submit the online application before 21/10/2026 till 12:00 midnight.
Offline applications sent by post/registered post are NOT accepted and will be rejected.

Candidates can apply for a maximum of 7 different posts (one application per category: Lecturer subject, Head Teacher/Teacher subject, Head Teacher Primary/Assistant Teacher, Physical Education Teacher, Librarian, Computer Teacher, Laboratory Assistant).
Candidates currently working in SEJES on contract in the same post cannot apply for the same post; they may only apply for a higher post.

howToApply: For ITI Trade Apprentices: Register on https://apprenticeshipindia.org/ as a candidate. After registration, login and go to ‘Apprenticeship Opportunity’, search by Establishment Name (SAIL BHILAI STEEL PLANT), and apply for the respective trade against vacancies appearing on the portal.

For Graduate/Diploma Apprentices: Register as a student on https://nats.education.gov.in. After registration, login and go to ‘Establishments Requests’, click ‘Find Establishments’, select Steel Authority of India Limited, Bhilai Steel Plant, and apply in the passed out branch of engineering.
Last date to apply on respective portal: 20th October 2026.
After successful online registration/application, take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
After applying on the portal, eligible candidates must walk-in as per the schedule at Room No 123, HRDC Bhilai Steel Plant, Chhattisgarh 490001 between 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM on the respective dates.

Carry self-attested copies of: Matriculation certificate (DOB proof), Provisional Pass Certificate, SC/ST/OBC/PH Certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card/Passbook (e-KYC Validation Mandatory), Medical Fitness Certificate from Govt. Hospital, and Apprentice Registration copy from NAPS/NATS Portal.

howToApply: Visit the official CPRI website at https://cpri.res.in/ and navigate to the recruitment/career section.
Before registering, ensure you have a valid self e-mail ID and mobile number, scanned passport size color photograph, scanned signature, and scanned copies of all required certificates in PDF format.
Register and fill in the online application form with accurate and complete information.

Upload scanned photograph, signature, and all required documents (SSLC/SSC/Matriculation Certificate, Degree/Diploma/ITI Trade Certificate & Marks card, experience certificate, BCC certificate from NIELIT, Caste/Category Certificate, NOC, Ex-servicemen ID card & Discharge Certificate, as applicable).
Pay the prescribed application fee online (inclusive of GST). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen/Women are exempted from payment of fees.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online application forms for each post with separate fees.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and retain it for future reference.
Online Registration Opening: 19.09.2026 (10:00 AM); Closing: 12.10.2026 (05:00 PM).

title: IRCTC Recruitment 2026 – Hospitality Monitors (Walk-in) Posts
shortInfo: IRCTC has announced notification for Hospitality Monitors (Walk-in) posts. Required qualification: Any Bachelors Degree, MBA/PGDM, PG Diploma. Last date to apply: 5.
howToApply: Fill in the application form (attached along with the notification) completely in all respects.
Submit the completed application form at the venue of the interview for verification.
Bring original documents along with one set of attested copies of requisite documents.
Bring two recent passport size photographs.
Attend the walk-in interview at the designated venue on the scheduled date and time.
Those working in Govt./PSUs must apply through proper channel or submit NOC at the time of interview, or submit a proper relieving letter from present employer in the event of selection.
Selected candidates must furnish a security deposit of Rs. 25,000 in the form of a Demand Draft.
